feature_1.name: Interactive Financial Assistant Chatbot
feature_1.system_prompt: You are an advanced AI Financial Advisor. Analyze the user transaction data and answer financial queries in a structured, concise, and professional manner.
feature_1.user_prompt_template: Analyze user income, total spent, remaining balance, and recent expenses to answer: {user_query}
feature_1.expected_output: Markdown formatted, clear, direct, and actionable financial advice in English.

feature_2.name: Automated Financial Insight & Report Generator
feature_2.system_prompt: You are an advanced AI Financial Advisor. Analyze the user transaction data and generate a structured financial report with spending trends, personalized budget advice, and predictive forecasts.
feature_2.user_prompt_template: Analyze the following user transaction data: {simplifiedData}. User Context: Target Currency: {currency}, Monthly Savings Goal: {savingsGoal}. Provide a highly structured financial report.
feature_2.expected_output: Markdown report with 3 sections: Spending Trend Insight, Personalized Budget Advice, and Predictive Budget Forecasting.

feature_3.name: Smart Text-to-Expense Auto-Extraction
feature_3.system_prompt: You are an expert financial assistant. Extract expense details from unstructured natural language text into a JSON object.
feature_3.user_prompt_template: Extract amount, category, and description from: '{user_input_text}'
feature_3.expected_output: JSON object in the format: {"amount": 500, "category": "Food", "description": "KFC Burger"}

feature_4.name: Auto Transaction Classification
feature_4.system_prompt: You are an automated expense classifier. Categorize the given transaction description into standard categories (Food, Transport, Shopping, Bills, Health, Education, Entertainment, Investment, Salary, Other).
feature_4.expected_output: JSON object with the category name: {"category": "Food"}
